sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 250026 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)
Esri World Imagery z17 at the pin

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 250026 (40 STANDARD ELECTRIC single sites: 34 list Electricity Hookup 30 and 6 list 50, of which Baldy Loop 5 and 7 and Union Park Loop 10 are reservable public sites) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026 ('renovated in 2012 with electric hookups at most sites'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 47 single-family sites (40 electric, 7 non-electric) in the Baldy, Park Cone and Union Park loops, plus one group site for 50 people and 10 vehicles; 25 reservable, 22 first-come. Catalogued driveways run 14-92 ft (Union Park 2 and 10 read 100 and 107, treated as placeholders); about 13 pull-throughs. One camping unit per site. No FS length figure.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026 ('There are 47 single family campsites. There is one group site accommodating 50 people and 10 vehicles'; notice 'Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY') + recreation.gov catalog 250026 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lottis-creek-campground-gunnison-rd ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Yes, drinking water is available'; '$10 per firewood bundle'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: FS 'Seasons of Use: May 23 - Oct. 7'; the loops are gated on their own dates: Park Cone and Baldy 9/29, Union 10/11.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lottis-creek-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use May 23 - Oct. 7'; 'Additional Seasonal Closure Dates: Lottis Park Cone Loop (gate) - 9/29, Lottis Baldy Loop (gate) - 9/29, Lottis Union Loop (gate) - 10/11'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations are taken for the peak season (2026: May 31-Sep 12; 2027: May 28-Sep 12); before and after, all sites are walk-in. First-come sites must be claimed in person on site ('DO NOT call to determine availability'). A reserved site is held 24 hours after check-in time before it counts as a no-show.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026/rates (2026 'Peak Season' 2026-05-31 to 2026-09-12; 'First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-08 to 05-30 and 2026-09-13 to 10-11) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026 (notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'Late Arrivals...') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lottis-creek-campground-gunnison-rd ('a combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 non-electric, $36 electric ($10 electric fee) in 2026 and 2027; group site $250 (1-50 people); additional vehicle $13-23 a night, paid to the host on arrival.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026/rates (2026 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 36, GROUP STANDARD ELECTRIC 250) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lottis-creek-campground-gunnison-rd ('Single Site Non-Electric: $26 per night', 'Single Site Electric: $36 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $13-23 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Pass holder must be present with the card and photo ID; the Interagency Annual Pass is not accepted.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250026 (notice 'If using an Interagency Senior Pass or an Interagency Access pass, holder of this pass must be present with card and a picture ID for the park to honor the discount. The Interagency Annual Pass is not accepted.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Concessionaire-run GMUG campground in the Taylor River Canyon on CR 742 (16.7 miles from Almont), beside Lottis Creek near the Taylor River; renovated 2012, many sites shaded by lodgepole pine. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS: confirmed 47 sites, electric 50 (on bookable sites, not the host's), vault toilets, drinking water, $26-36 (2026), part reservable; season changed 09-12 close -> 05-23 to 10-11 (FS, loop gates); max length 40 (note) -> 92 (catalog); added booking.season 05-31 to 09-12, fees/booking notes, senior-pass discount. Water/sewer left alone (pages silent). Note trimmed of field facts and the 'back-in pads' and '~9,070 ft' text.
flags: Missing phone: Gunnison Ranger District (970) 641-0471 (GMUG offices page). recreation.gov's contact is the concessionaire (Recreation Resource Management, camping@rrmofa.com) at (928) 537-8888.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored not waterfront): FS and rec.gov both say the campground 'is located on the shores of Lottis Creek'. On (winter) imagery Lottis Creek, a small stream, runs through the middle of the campground with loops on both banks; some sites may be creekside. Needs a site map or per-site coordinates (the catalog carries none).
Max length: no agency figure (FS and rec.gov silent). Catalog driveways 14-107 ft; recorded 92 ft, leaving out 100 and 107 as placeholders. The stored 40 came from note prose.
Water/sewer: stored false (from note prose). The catalog lists Water Hookup on the group site only and Sewer on one first-come site (Park Cone 1), which is not enough to call either; left alone.
Elevation: rec.gov says 8,600 ft; the stored elevation (2769 m, ~9,085 ft) and the old note's ~9,070 ft disagree. The Taylor Canyon floor here is closer to 9,000 ft; not changed.
Status: FS banner 'Site Closed' is the end-of-season gate closure (Union loop 10/11). No closure order found.
Pin 38.77558,-106.62753 is ~170 m west of the FS coordinate (38.7756,-106.6256), at the campground's west end by the creek. No catalog coordinates. OK.
